verdict.rationale: Texas SOS is a business-filing service, and such services can plausibly publish APIs or SDKs, so this axis applies. The evidence describes only the SOSPortal web interface, PDF forms, and pay-per-search access, with no official SDK or developer library. The robots.txt probe shows AI crawlers are blocked by name, which is unrelated to SDK availability and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
